title: tx.origin used for authorization (solidity) — review required
description: A solidity contract reads tx.origin in an authorization check. tx.origin is the externally owned account that started the transaction, so an intermediary contract the owner calls can pass the check. This lexical rule flags the read; the reviewer confirms tx.origin never decides access.
remediation: Authorize with msg.sender and keep tx.origin out of access checks.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any tx.origin reference matches, including non-authorization reads such as logging.
